sql.statement:
SELECT
    lp.enrollment_id AS loyalty_program_id,
    lp.enrollment_date AS program_date,
    SUM(lpe.points) * 0.01 AS points_cost,
    SUM(COALESCE(ol.revenue, 0)) AS attributed_revenue
FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_loyalty_points_earned lpe
JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_loyalty_enrollment lp ON lpe.customer_id = lp.customer_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_header oh ON lpe.customer_id = oh.customer_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_line ol ON oh.order_id = ol.order_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
